import subprocess,hashlib
out=subprocess.run(["git","log","--format=%H %aI %s","--","tools/mutate-and-run.sh"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
print("commits-touching-harness",len(out))
for line in out:
    h,d,s=line.split(" ",2)
    b=subprocess.run(["git","show",h+":tools/mutate-and-run.sh"],capture_output=True).stdout
    print(h[:12],d,hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:12],s[:70])
